# AstryxAvatar { #anylumino.AstryxAvatar }

```python
AstryxAvatar(name, **props)
```

Render an Astryx avatar.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Default    |
|---------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| name    | str    | Astryx component option.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | _required_ |
| **props | Any    | JSON-safe Avatar props. Useful keys: src, fallbackSrc, alt, size, status, className, and style. The Python name argument provides the accessible fallback name. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Avatar>. | `{}`       |
